mapper.sql:
select u.user_id, u.tenant_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.user_type, u.email, u.avatar, u.phone_number, u.password, u.sex, u.enable, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.is_administrator, u.we_chat, u.password_strength, u.phone_verified, u.email_verified, u.password_last_date,
d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader_id, d.enable, d.email as dept_email, d.create_time as dept_cteate_time, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.order_num, r.data_scope, r.enable as role_enable, p.post_id, p.post_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role sur on u.user_id = sur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = sur.role_id left join sys_user_post spr on u.user_id = spr.user_id left join sys_post p on p.post_id = spr.post_id
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phone_number, u.sex, u.enable, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, d.leader_id, d.leader_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user u1 on u1.user_id = d.leader_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phone_number, u.sex, u.enable, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, d.leader_id, d.leader_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user u1 on u1.user_id = d.leader_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.enable, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role sur on u.user_id = sur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = sur.role_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.enable, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role sur on u.user_id = sur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = sur.role_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
where u.del_flag = '0' and (u.user_name = #{userName} or u.phone_number = #{userName} or u.email = #{userName}) and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
where u.del_flag = '0' and u.phone_number = #{phoneNumber} and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
where u.del_flag = '0' and u.email = #{email} and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
